outcome: cerebral tissue oxygenation index (cTOI) to peripheral muscle tissue oxygenation index (pTOI) ratio
cohort: Eighty-seven cardio-circulatory stable preterm neonates (33.1 [32.1-34.1] weeks of gestation) without signs of inflammation/infection were included.
finding: The courses of the cTOI/pTOI-ratio and cTOI showed significantly lower values from hour 5 to 15 compared to the first hours after birth.
cross-section timing: Observations were taken over a 24-hour period during the first day after birth.
